(()=>{const plate=document.querySelector('.iso-plate').getBoundingClientRect();const out={};for(const g of document.querySelectorAll('[data-name]')){const n=g.dataset.name.replace(/#.*/,'');const b=g.getBoundingClientRect();const k=n;(out[k]??=[]).push([b.x-plate.x,b.y-plate.y,b.width,b.height].map(v=>Math.round(v)).join(','));}return Object.entries(out).map(([k,v])=>k+': '+v.join(' | ')).join('\n');})()
